name: span list, 1 service, 15 min, promoted attribute
sql: select timestamp, name, duration_nano, http_route from spans where service_name = 'svc-19' and timestamp > now() - interval '15 minutes' and http_method = 'GET' order by timestamp desc limit 100

name: p99 latency per service, 24 h
sql: select service_name, approx_percentile_cont(duration_nano, 0.99) as p99, count(*) as n from spans where timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours' group by service_name order by n desc

name: dashboard: rate and errors per service, last 5 min
sql: select service_name, count(*) as n, sum(case when has_error then 1 else 0 end) as errors from spans where timestamp > now() - interval '5 minutes' group by service_name

name: top operations by p95, 1 h
sql: select service_name, name, approx_percentile_cont(duration_nano, 0.95) as p95 from spans where timestamp > now() - interval '1 hour' group by service_name, name order by p95 desc limit 20
